description: Normalized signal rows imported from a project's connected sources. Best for: reading the evidence base behind Marketing Signal measure-stage findings. Not for: provider availability (index365_list_integrations). Common mistake: treating an empty list as an error; it stays empty with sourceCoverage public_only until integrations launch. Example: index365_list_connected_signals({ projectId: '<uuid>' }). Next: index365_start_scan with product marketing_signal to score the site against these signals.
name: index365_list_connected_signals
title: List connected-source signals
